records.jp: いいけど……ただし、ひとつ条件がある！
records.en_original: Sure...On one condition!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure...On one condition!
records.en: Sure... but on one condition!

records.jp: へ？　条件？
records.en_original: Huh? A condition?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? A condition?
records.en: Huh? A condition?

records.jp: …………。<CR>愛央、これ、一体何？
records.en_original: Ao... What is this...?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... What is this...?
records.en: ............<CR>Ao, what exactly is this?

records.jp: 何って……筋トレ？　オリジナルだけど
records.en_original: Weights, duh. I made them.
records.en_auxiliary: Weights, duh. I made them.
records.en: What do you mean... strength training? It's original, though.

records.jp: それってつまりテキトーってことじゃん！？<CR>ていうか、なんで筋トレ！？　つまんないよ！
records.en_original: You made them?! Wait, but why weights? Lifting isn't any fun!
records.en_auxiliary: You made them?! Wait, but why weights? Lifting isn't any fun!
records.en: That just means you're making it up as you go!?<CR>And why strength training!? This is boring!

records.jp: えー。屋上に来る代わりに、何で遊ぶかは私が<CR>決めるって条件だったっしょ？
records.en_original: Hey, you said I could decide what we do if I went with you to the roof.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, you said I could decide what we do if I went with you to the roof.
records.en: Ehh? My condition for coming to the rooftop was<CR>that I got to decide what we played, remember?

records.jp: それにほら、こうしてゆっくり動くだけでも<CR>結構いい運動に……
records.en_original: It might not be quite as active as other stuff, but it's still a pretty good workout.
records.en_auxiliary: It might not be quite as active as other stuff, but it's still a pretty good workout.
records.en: And look, even moving slowly like this<CR>is pretty good exercise...

records.jp: 愛央。今日の愛央の行動と、あたしがこの間<CR>倒れちゃったこと、関係ある？
records.en_original: Ao. Does this have anything to do with me collapsing the other day?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. Does this have anything to do with me collapsing the other day?
records.en: Ao. Is what you're doing today related to<CR>me collapsing the other day?

records.jp: う……。<CR>……あ、ある
records.en_original: Urk... Y-yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk... Y-yes...
records.en: Ugh...<CR>...Y-yes.

records.jp: やっぱりさ、毎回体力がからっぽになるまで<CR>遊んでるのって、さすがに無理しすぎだよ
records.en_original: I just thought, you can't play until you're completely exhausted every single day.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought, you can't play until you're completely exhausted every single day.
records.en: Playing until your stamina is completely empty<CR>every single time is pushing yourself too far.

records.jp: それに、少しでも長く一緒に居られる方が<CR>私は嬉しいし
records.en_original: Besides, I'd be happy if we could spend a bit more time together.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, I'd be happy if we could spend a bit more time together.
records.en: And I'd be happier if we could stay together<CR>even a little longer.

records.jp: 走り回って、ダウンして終わり、じゃなくて、<CR>体を休めながらのんびり過ごして……
records.en_original: Rather than running around a bunch, I thought we could just chill and enjoy ourselves.
records.en_auxiliary: Rather than running around a bunch, I thought we could just chill and enjoy ourselves.
records.en: Instead of running around, collapsing, and being done,<CR>we could take it easy while letting your body rest...

records.jp: ふーん。愛央はそういう考え方なんだ
records.en_original: Huh. I guess that's an idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh. I guess that's an idea.
records.en: Huh. So that's how you see it, Ao.

records.jp: あたしとは全然違うね。あたしは体を休めて<CR>じっとしてるのなんて、もうこりごりだから
records.en_original: I don't agree at all. I've had enough lying around for a lifetime.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't agree at all. I've had enough lying around for a lifetime.
records.en: That's completely different from how I see it. I've had enough<CR>of resting my body and lying still.

records.jp: （しまった……私、勇希の気持ち、<CR>ちゃんと考えられてなかったかも）
records.en_original: (Shoot... I don't think I took Yuki's feelings into consideration.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Shoot... I don't think I took Yuki's feelings into consideration.)
records.en: (Oh no... Maybe I hadn't properly considered<CR>how Yuki felt.)

records.jp: （勇希のためだって思ってたけど、病気の辛さを<CR>知らない私の、価値観の押し付けだった？）
records.en_original: (I thought it was for her own good, but I didn't even think about her illness.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I thought it was for her own good, but I didn't even think about her illness.)
records.en: (I thought it was for Yuki's sake, but was I forcing my values on her<CR>when I don't know the pain of being sick?)

records.jp: 勇希、ごめ──
records.en_original: Yuki, I—
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki, I—
records.en: Yuki, I—

records.jp: ごめん……！
records.en_original: I'm sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry!
records.en: I'm sorry!

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: あたし、言い方悪かった
records.en_original: I shouldn't have worded it like that.
records.en_auxiliary: I shouldn't have worded it like that.
records.en: I said it badly.

records.jp: 病気のこと……とか、いろいろ、ちゃんと<CR>愛央と話したわけじゃないのに
records.en_original: I haven't even talked to you about when I was sick.
records.en_auxiliary: I haven't even talked to you about when I was sick.
records.en: I haven't properly talked with you about my illness<CR>or any of that yet.

records.jp: あたしの気持ちをわかってない、みたいな<CR>言い方……ずるかったね。ごめん
records.en_original: It wasn't fair of me to accuse you of not understanding how I feel.
records.en_auxiliary: It wasn't fair of me to accuse you of not understanding how I feel.
records.en: Saying it like you didn't understand my feelings<CR>was unfair of me. Sorry.

records.jp: ……謝ることなんてないよ。実際私、<CR>勇希の気持ちを考えられてなかったもん
records.en_original: You have no reason to apologize. You were right.
records.en_auxiliary: You have no reason to apologize. You were right.
records.en: ...You don't have to apologize. The truth is,<CR>I hadn't considered how you felt.

records.jp: 勇希……？
records.en_original: Yuki...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...?
records.en: Yuki...?

records.jp: あたしのこと心配して、<CR>いろいろ考えてくれたのはとっても嬉しい
records.en_original: I'm really happy that you would worry so much about me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm really happy that you would worry so much about me.
records.en: I'm really happy that you worried about me<CR>and thought through so many things.

records.jp: それは……本当だから……
records.en_original: I mean that.
records.en_auxiliary: I mean that.
records.en: That's... true...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Got it...
records.en_auxiliary: Got it...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: （……勇希、なんだかんだ優しいよね。<CR>次に遊ぶ時は、もっとやり方を考えてみよう……）
records.en_original: (Yuki is a sweet girl. I'll have to think of more things we can do next time.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yuki is a sweet girl. I'll have to think of more things we can do next time.)
records.en: (...Yuki is kind, one way or another.<CR>Next time we play, I'll think more carefully about how we do it.)

records.jp: <CLGR>勇希<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Yuki's<CLNR> Talents.
